items.scene: A glass of red wine in tiny sunglasses sits on its barrel looking so al-COOL (ahl-KOL): ALCOHOL. Nobody drinks it.
A ghost shouts 'BOO!' (boo-SHOHN) as it heaves a giant CORK over its head.
A cellar hand yells 'TOE! NO!' (toh-NOH) as a runaway BARREL rolls into his foot.
A delivery VAN (VAN) has backed down the ramp with its doors open, packed with crates of WINE.
